_note: Two Library groups hold both a tradition's own writings and later books about or out of it, so the index takes from them only the ids listed here: ec (early Christian and Gnostic writings; the later Christian classics that quote and comment on scripture are left out like the Church Fathers) and mo (modern and revival traditions: the new scriptures are in, their authors' sermons, treatises and philosophy are out). The first block of each list is what the index held on 15 November 2026; the second is what was added on 17 November 2026 (Coptic and Mandaean texts, the Paulician and Ethiopian books, the hymns of the Russian Church; the Seven Valleys, the Holy Piby and the Moorish Holy Koran). Tried and left out: the Book of Mormon, Doctrine and Covenants, Pearl of Great Price, Oahspe, the Aquarian Gospel and Science and Health, which quote or retell the Bible so closely that, with them in, they took 110 of the 760 best-ten places of the benchmark's questions from under 3% of the passages and the curated pairs shown fell from 19 to 16 of 76 (tools/similar_bench.js --crowd and --leave). Every other group is indexed unless its shelf is shelf-only (LIB_SHELF_ONLY in src/js/24-data-path-lib.js) or the id is in tools/similar_skip.json. Read by tools/build_similar.js.
